title: Protocol to drive human monocyte-to-macrophage polarization in vitro using tumor conditioned media
protocol: Seed 1 × 10^6 CD14+ monocytes in 1 mL of RPMI complete in a 24-well plate.
Incubate the seeded cells at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Harvest melanoma cells from the cell culture flask for tumor conditioned media preparation.
Aspirate culture media and wash detached cells with PBS (−/− CaCl2/MgCl2).
Incubate the washed cells with trypsin for 1–2 minutes at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Resuspend the detached cells in DMEM complete.
Centrifuge the resuspended cells at 300 × g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend the centrifuged cells in fresh DMEM complete.
Seed 2.5 × 10^5 melanoma cells in 2 mL/T6 well of DMEM complete overnight.
Wash tumor cells twice with PBS (+/+ CaCl2/MgCl2).
Add 1 mL of serum-free DMEM (1% Penicillin-Streptomycin) per T6 well.
Incubate cells at 37°C, 10% CO2 for 48 h for media conditioning.
Harvest conditioned media from cell culture wells.
Centrifuge the harvested media at 500 × g for 5 min to discard dead cells and debris.
Transfer supernatant into Amicon-Ultra 3 kDa filter-pore falcons (Millipore).
Centrifuge at 4,000 rpm in a swinging bucket rotor for 45 min at 4°C.
Quantify conditioned media samples via BCA assay as per manufacturer’s instructions.
Titrate conditioned media with several dilutions to find an optimal concentration for analysis from the BCA standard curve.
Run serum-free DMEM as a blank at the same dilution factor as your samples.
Normalize protein from each condition by resuspending desired conditioned media volumes into RPMI complete media at a concentration of 70 μg/mL (2×).
Carefully take out 50% media from macrophage T24-wells and add 500 μL of 2× protein solution to achieve a final concentration of 35 μg/mL.
Pipette slowly at the side of the well to avoid disrupting the monocytes.
Include a negative control of monocytes alone (RPMI media only).
Use IL-4 (20 ng/mL), IL-10 (20 ng/mL), and M-CSF (50 ng/mL) as positive controls for inducing alternatively-activated macrophages.
Use IFN-γ (20 ng/mL) plus LPS (100 ng/mL) to induce classically-activated macrophages.
Acquire bright-field images of macrophages at 10–20× magnification.
Analyze cell morphological differences by ImageJ software.
Collect macrophage supernatants from all conditions.
Transfer supernatants into separate Eppendorfs.
Add 1 mL pre-cooled PBS (−/− CaCl2/MgCl2) to each well.
Place plates on ice for 30 min.
Spin down cell supernatants at 300 × g for 5 min.
Resuspend in 100 μL FACS buffer (PBS−/−, 1% BSA, 2 mM EDTA, 0.1% NaN3).
Gently scrape off the cells with the flat end of a P1000 tip.
Pipette up and down before transferring cells into a fresh Eppendorf tube.
Combine cells with supernatant fractions.
Centrifuge tubes at 300 × g for 5 min.
Perform a second wash with 1 mL FACS buffer.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Resuspend in 100 μL FACS buffer and human TruStain FcX blocking solution (1:20).
Incubate for 10 min at room temperature.
Vortex gently.
Take a small proportion from each individual condition to create a pool sample or allocate conditions for unstained and DAPI single stain control.
Transfer into a new Eppendorf tube.
Spin down samples at 300 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Resuspend in FACS buffer containing a mixture of a 4-color antibody panel, with a total volume of 100 μL.
Vortex samples gently.
Incubate for 30 min at 4°C in the dark.
Wash twice with FACS buffer.
Resuspend in DAPI solution (5 μg/mL) for live/dead cell separation.
Acquire live samples on a flow cytometer (BD FACS CANTO II).
Optional: Fix cells in 1% formaldehyde (10 min room temperature incubation).
Centrifuge and resuspend in FACS buffer kept at 4°C if analyzing later or the following day.
Prepare compensation beads to correct for fluorescence spill over from fluorochrome-conjugated antibodies.
Add one drop each of MACS Comp Beads (anti-mouse Igκ) and MACS Comp Beads (blank) to 100 μL FACS buffer.
For each single stained control, add the same antibody dilution.
Acquire brightfield microscopy images of differentiated macrophages on day 6.
Import images into ImageJ software.
Generate automatic cell shape descriptor measurements using the ‘freehand selection’ tool in ImageJ.
Manually categorize cells into distinct subsets such as elongated/spindle or spread/fried egg.
Trypsinize and count melanoma target cells (A375M2, WM88).
Label tumor cells with CFSE following manufacturer’s instructions.
Incubate cells for 20 min at room temperature or 37°C protected from light.
Quench the staining by adding 5 times the original volume of cell culture media containing 10% FBS.
Wash CFSE-labeled melanoma cells and macrophages in complete RPMI before co-culture.
Add targets (10^4 melanoma cells) to macrophages (10^5 macrophages) at a ratio of 1:10 (targets: effectors) in complete RPMI.
Incubate for 48 h in 48-well plates in duplicates.
Harvest cells with trypsin upon incubation completion.
Wash the cells with FACS buffer.
Resuspend cells in DAPI solution for viability staining.
Acquire on a flow cytometer (BD FACS CANTO II).
Discriminate two cell populations by flow cytometry analysis: CFSE+DAPI+ (dead tumor cells).
